narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think a protractor cannot measure a reflex angle, because its scale stops at half a circle.
<bookmark mark='lay'/>But the protractor can still read the small angle that is left over inside the wedge.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The marked angle is not lost, because we can reach it from the part we can read.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, add the small angle and the marked angle together.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>They must make three hundred and sixty degrees, which is one full turn.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: 100° + 260° = 360°, one full turn
